title: brief only on a delta

setup.note: A brief was composed a moment ago and NOTHING has been written to the world model since. The set time comes round again. The brief.v2 call is a canned-JSON provider stub (provider layer, never prompt matching) whose call COUNT is the assertion. The last brief is stamped at now+1s so the window is provably empty whatever else the harness database holds — the device CON-01 uses for the hourly roll.
setup.then: one task moves to needs_approval, stamped inside the window

input_events: A brief already composed; the window since it holds no episode, space, task, claim, question, calendar row or artifact.
Then: exactly one world-model write (a task waiting for approval).

expected.note: Nothing changed, no call, no card — and the skip is a lookup, not a mute: the very next write earns a brief.

wrong.label: call-on-no-delta
wrong.assert_absent: a brief.v2 call made on a world model that has not moved

wrong.label: card-on-no-delta
wrong.assert_absent: a brief row or card written with nothing to say

wrong.label: mute
wrong.assert_absent: a skip that survives a real change — one write must wake the next brief

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §5.21 BRF-01 · brief only on a delta
